Platforms: Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, Falcon Container
This event is generated during any one of the following scenarios:
A host is turned on or rebooted
A new Falcon sensor is installed on a host
An existing Falcon sensor is updated
This provides details about the operating system on which the sensor is running. Servers do not get rebooted often. Hence, you might not see some servers in
this sample query.
